Dear Actief Oostkamp team,

I am writing to apply for the Warehouse Worker position in Oostkamp, as advertised. I have warehouse experience from my time at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, where I worked in a high-volume logistics environment, maintaining accuracy and efficiency. I am comfortable with physical work and cold environments, and I have my own transportation to Oostkamp.

I am eager to contribute to your team and grow within the company. I am available to start immediately and can work in a 2-shift system. English is my professional working language, and I am also learning Dutch (currently B1).

Please find my CV attached for your consideration. I would be delighted to discuss how my experience and work ethic can benefit your logistics operations.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Warehouse Worker position at your logistics company in Oostkamp, as advertised through Actief Oostkamp. With hands-on experience in a high-volume logistics environment and a strong work ethic, I am confident that I can contribute effectively to your team.

During my time at Katoen Natie in Antwerp, I worked in a fast-paced warehouse setting where accuracy and efficiency were paramount. I am comfortable with physical tasks, including loading and unloading, and I am not afraid of working in cold environments. I have experience using electric pallet trucks (EPT) and am keen to expand my skills with reach truck training, which I understand is available after a period of employment.

I am already living in Belgium with a valid address and have full legal permission to work. I have my own transportation to Oostkamp, ensuring reliable attendance for the 2-shift system. I am available to start as soon as possible and am looking for a stable, long-term opportunity.

Although my recent professional focus has been in digital marketing, my warehouse experience has given me a solid foundation in logistics operations. I am known for my reliability, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively in a team. I am eager to bring my dedication and physical capability to your company and grow within a stable sector.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience and motivation align with your needs. I am available for an interview at your convenience.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
